messages:
maya: Quick sync notes from this morning's design review. I uploaded a 'pool grid' prototype that groups pools by latency + cost tier and introduces a compact mode toggle. Link: https://figma.redwood/pool-grid-v1

ryan: Thanks. Can someone paste the key screens? I'm on mobile.

maya: pasted: main changes -> grid layout with cards, compact mode reduces padding & hides long descriptions, global SLO moved to page header but each pool shows a small "min SLO" pill.

kevin: Main concern: grid semantics for keyboard users. Cards need a clear tab order and arrow-key nav behavior. Recommend `role="grid"` with `aria-rowindex`/`aria-colindex` and a roving tabindex pattern.

anna: Accessibility: don't rely on color to convey pool state. Add text labels like "Healthy"/"Degraded" below pool name and include `aria-live="polite"` for state transitions when autoscale changes a pool.

emily: Copy tweak: the header label "SLO target" reads fine but tooltip should be "Service level objective (global target for request success/availability)". For the per-pool pill use "Min SLO" not just "SLO".

ryan: Compact mode question: when compact hides descriptions, how do screen reader users get the info? Need an expand toggle per card or ensure key metadata is always in DOM but visually hidden.

kevin: Agree. Keep info in DOM with `sr-only` text. Keyboard: implement a visible focus ring and ensure focus doesn't get trapped in nested controls. For arrow nav: right -> next card, down -> next row of cards. Provide `aria-keyshortcuts` for toggling compact mode (e.g., `c`).

anna: Microcopy for burst action: avoid verb 'start' alone. Use "Enable temporary capacity" and show duration and est. cost. Also include an accessible confirmation flow: modal with `role=dialog`, focus trap, and `aria-describedby` referencing cost summary.

emily: Cost delta microcopy: show inline badge like "+2.1% est cost" and tooltip text "Estimated change in monthly inference cost". Keep values rounded to one decimal.

maya: Product note: global SLO is default. Per-pool override available via a small chevron -> inline editor. When overridden show a small lock icon that toggles between locked (follows global) and unlocked (overridden). Tooltip strings needed.

kevin: For reorder: in grid view we need both drag handles and keyboard reorder. Use `aria-grabbed` on the grabbed item and `aria-dropeffect` or update order announcement to SR: "Pool X moved to position Y". Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` for animations.

ryan: Legend placement idea: put a compact summary at top-left (counts + quick filter) and a full legend accessible via a disclosure in top-right. On narrow screens collapse to a single line: "4 pools 3 healthy" that expands.

anna: A11y snippet suggestion to include in figma notes: example `aria-label` for burst pill: `aria-label=\"Temporary capacity: adds 2 GPUs for 20 minutes, estimated cost +1.8%\"`. Also example SR announcement: `aria-live=\"assertive\"` "Burst enabled on pool X, estimated +1.8% cost".

emily: Copy nit: change button "Add burst" to "Add temporary capacity". Also change confirm CTA from "Confirm" to "Enable temporary capacity".

maya: plan: update figma with aria snippets, add compact-mode toggle in header, wire up inline cost badges, and annotate keyboard order. Will push v1.1 by tomorrow morning.

ops-bot: FYI: autoscale-api has a new draft endpoint for bursts: POST /pools/{id}/burst with payload {"gpus":2, "duration_mins":20}. Confirm expected latency before frontend integration.

kevin: I'll validate keyboard flow against the API sim tomorrow. Also logging note: announce optimistic UI change then confirm when API responds. Use `aria-live=polite` for optimistic updates and `assertive` for failures.

maya: great. @emily can you update the tooltip copy? @kevin and @anna pair on keyboard + SR text. @ryan please test compact-mode behavior on mobile.

design-bot: Design review requested: prototype https://figma.redwood/pool-grid-v1; reviewers: @kevin @anna @emily; due in 36h.

ryan: leaving some comments in figma after lunch.

maya: thanks all 10: will post final notes when v1.1 is up.
